brief: Apply the loading restriction in MG-021 to the Marlow Crossing transformer ahead of the forecast heat event, as the unit cannot be attended before the event in accordance with MG-023. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period as required by MG-021. Restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified, rather than when the event ends, following MG-021.
